entities.summary: Sincan is a municipality and metropolitan district of Ankara Province, Turkey. Its area is 880 km2, and its population is 572,609 (2022). It is a large town 27 km from the city of Ankara. Its elevation is 789 m (2,589 ft). Sincan has friendly relations with the municipality of Doboj Jug from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
